'''Docking Slip 120-54''' was a location in the [[Grallia Spaceport]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. Although it was 40 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away from the network of old quarries and mines known as the [[jump quarries]], the two locations were connected by a tunnel network created by a cell of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="CatCW" />
